turns.q: Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
turns.replyTail: depends on the size of the space and how quickly you want it to clean the air. - If your main room is within the BreatheSmart 35i range (700–1,400 sq ft), the 35i is usually fine and the better value. - The BreatheSmart 45i is worth the extra cost when you’re using it in a larger primary room (up to 950–1,900 sq ft) or you want more cleaning power (higher CADR: ~255 vs ~190). If you’re buying for a typical bedroom or office, I’d lean 35i. If it’s for a bigger living room/open area, I’d lean 45i.
